name: vscode-folder-file-filter
description: Filter files by glob mask inside a selected VS Code Explorer folder.

folderFileFilter.defaultMask.description: Default glob mask shown when filtering files in a selected folder.
folderFileFilter.defaultMask.markdownDescription: Default glob mask shown when filtering files in a selected folder.

folderFileFilter.maxResults.description: Maximum number of files returned by one folder file filter search.
folderFileFilter.maxResults.markdownDescription: Maximum number of files returned by one folder file filter search.

folderFileFilter.openOnSelection.description: Open the selected result immediately while moving through the Folder File Filter results list. Files open with their default editor in preview mode and focus stays in the results view.
folderFileFilter.openOnSelection.markdownDescription: Open the selected result immediately while moving through the Folder File Filter results list. Files open with their default editor in preview mode and focus stays in the results view.

folderFileFilter.autoFilterFilesFromSele.description: When running Folder File Filter from a file, immediately show files in the same folder that match the selected file extension. Disable to confirm or edit the inferred mask first.
folderFileFilter.autoFilterFilesFromSele.markdownDescription: When running Folder File Filter from a file, immediately show files in the same folder that match the selected file extension. Disable to confirm or edit the inferred mask first.

folderFileFilter.autoFilterFromActiveFil.description: Automatically update Folder File Filter when the active editor tab changes to a file. The filter uses that file's parent folder and inferred extension mask.
folderFileFilter.autoFilterFromActiveFil.markdownDescription: Automatically update Folder File Filter when the active editor tab changes to a file. The filter uses that file's parent folder and inferred extension mask.

folderFileFilter.restoreFocusAfterOpenDe.description: Delay before Folder File Filter restores focus again after auto-opening a result. Increase this if a custom editor takes focus after opening; set to 0 to disable delayed refocus.
folderFileFilter.restoreFocusAfterOpenDe.markdownDescription: Delay before Folder File Filter restores focus again after auto-opening a result. Increase this if a custom editor takes focus after opening; set to `0` to disable delayed refocus.

commands.title: Folder File Filter: Show Matching Files

viewsWelcome.contents: Right-click a folder in Explorer and run `Folder File Filter: Show Matching Files`.

scripts.package: npm run compile && vsce package --no-dependencies --readme-path README.marketplace.md
